"Ah... is this recording channel secure? To whoever is receiving this data packet inside the grid: I am Dr. Aris Vance. If you are reading this, our cybernetic expedition has officially launched. The wildlands of WildPulse are dangerous, but our bio-digital research holds the key. Listen closely to these core directives to survive and unlock the grid's mysteries:"

  • 🌐 Traverse & Map: Navigate our expanded 60,000px territory. Changing seasons and heavy storm weather directly boost your walking speed—use it to map every sector!
  • ⚔️ Tactical Combat: To build our specimen database, engage and weaken wild creatures. Once their grid signal is low, capture them to secure their physical form in your active party.
  • 🧬 DNA Breeding Program: My crowning achievement. When your trainer clearance reaches Level 7, combine any male and female specimen at the Breeding Center to synthesize a Mysterious Egg. You must physically walk 1,000 steps with the egg in your active party to hatch its DNA structure. Hatching reveals the newborn's hidden stats, nature, temperament, and mutations! (Note: stored eggs won't progress).
  • 🏠 Safe Haven: When your trainer clearance reaches Level 10, your Home Teleporter will unlock, granting you a personal home base! You can instantly travel to your home, and back to the hospital! While inside or near your home, press H or Start to access the Home Design modal, where you can freely place, rotate, and arrange furniture items acquired from quests or the Store to customize your sanctuary.
  • ❤️ Mutual Symbiosis: Active companionship generates trust. Keeping a creature by your side actively builds Happiness and unlocks passive experience gains.
  • 👑 Sector Dominance: Challenge 24 elite wandering trainers spread across the grid, trade creatures with other field operatives, or test your squad in the high-stakes Crown Challenges.

*** [ CYBERNETIC FIELD GUIDE & ARCHIVE ] ***

"Welcome, Operative. This terminal contains essential logs from Dr. Aris Vance. Refer to these entries to manage your active creatures, navigate the grid coordinates safely, and survive the challenges of the Wildlands."

🎮 MODULE_01: CONTROL INTERFACE

• Movement: Walk using W, A, S, D or Arrow Keys on PC, the Left Stick / D-Pad on Gamepads, or by touching and dragging on mobile viewports.

• Action Wheel: Tap Q on PC, hold Right Bumper on your Gamepad, or double-tap the screen on Mobile. Navigate choices using the D-Pad and press A to confirm.

• Inventory Wheel: Hold I on PC or the Left Bumper on Gamepads to access item slots quickly. Releasing the key or button closes the wheel.

• Virtual Cursor: Use the Gamepad Right Stick to move separate virtual cursors in menu screens. Select items with A and close menus with B.

🧬 MODULE_02: COMPANION BIOMES & STATS

• Creature Stats: Every companion has six core attributes: HP (Health), Atk (Physical Strike), Def (Physical Shield), Spe (Speed), SpA (Special Strike), and SpD (Special Shield).

• Bonding & Growth: Keep companions in your active party to gain +1 Friend XP and +1 Happiness every 30 seconds. Leveling up grants +2 bonus points across random stats. On multiples of Level 10, all stats get a boost. Stored companions slowly lose -1 XP and -1 Happiness every 180 seconds.

• Managing Happiness: Values range from 0 to 100. Choose **Pet** on your active wheel or feed them **Creature Cookies** (+10 Happiness, 5-minute cooldown) to lift spirits. Fainting in battle decreases happiness by -15.

🔬 MODULE_03: DNA SYNTHESIS & HATCHING

• Breeding Program: Unlocks at Player Level 7. Combine traits by selecting one Male and one Female parent at the Breeding Center. Eggs themselves cannot breed.

• Mysterious Eggs: Eggs inherit dual-color linear gradients from their parents. Their stats, mutations, and temperaments are hidden under '???' until hatched. Keep them in your active party and walk 1000 steps to hatch them.

• Pedometer 👣: Buy this from the shop for 220 gold. Use it to gain a 60-second buff that doubles your step speed toward hatching eggs.

• Mutations & Traits: Breeding yields chances to pass down any of 18 unique mutations (such as Bioluminescent Core or Double Helix) and 16 temperaments. Check these details on the full-size preview screen.

⛩️ MODULE_04: GRID CONFLICTS & LOGISTICS

• Wandering Trainers: Challenge the 24 elite trainers scattered across the world to win gold. Defeated trainers display green nameplates and a 🏆 trophy.

• Dojo Challenge: Defeat all 24 trainers to unlock the Dojo Tile in the shop for 920 gold. Placed Dojo Tiles let you fight the Dojo Leader in scalable boss battles.

• Sanctuary Base: Once you reach Player Level 10, place your Home. Step inside and select '🎨 Design' on your Action Wheel to change walls, floors, and ambient glows.

• Storage Chest 🧳: Available at Player Level 6. Purchase for 620 gold and place up to 3 chests to store your extra item stacks (maximum 10 per slot).

• Item Catalog: Visit the store to buy recovery items, **Creature Licenses** (provides a passive 1.5x capture rate, consumed only on successful catch), and **Jank Juice** (increases shiny spawn rates for 6 minutes).

• Hidden Grove Portals ${window.getPortalIconHTML(16)}: Under specific environmental alignments (Fall Thunderstorms at Night, Winter Thundersnows at Night, Spring Rains at Sunrise, or Summer Storms at Sunset), 3 rare procedurally placed portals materialize across the map. Step through them to access the mysterious, high-stakes 40x40 Hidden Grove Portal World, filled with completely unique flora, glowing grass, much higher shiny rates, and high-level creatures! Step on the center return portal to return to safety.
